fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-08-26 (afternoon, 16:20): A person offering to buy an item listed online asked the complainant to approve a UPI request, following which Rs. 15,000 was withdrawn. Sangeetha Bai submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000261. The account reference SYN-ACC-100098 was noted in connection with the payment. Chandran Krishnan (9000000031) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complaint mentions Vasanth Gopal, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000245, in connection with the events.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as an online buyer and requested payment approval.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, afternoon, receiving account, witness, mobile number, suspect, shopping complex
